prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for this, if that's fine.

Q: That's acceptable. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pearland, in the right lane. I had been waiting maybe half a minute when I felt a hard jolt from behind.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only in the mirror, for a second. It looked like it was coming up fast, and I braced myself on the wheel. There wasn't time to do anything else.

Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was traveling?

A: I really can't say. It seemed quicker than traffic around it, but I'm not good at judging speed from a mirror.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did your airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not come out, I don't think.

Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?

A: I think my head snapped back and hit the headrest, and then forward. Right after, I had a headache, ringing in my ears, and I felt foggy and kind of nauseous.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I was taken to an urgent care clinic and later saw my primary doctor. They told me I have a concussion and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.

Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?

A: Some of them, yes. Bright lights bother me, and I get tired by the afternoon. I'm trying to take it easy.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm glad no one else was seriously hurt, and I'd appreciate a call back if you need anything else from me.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
